metric: Count of braid cube sample points inside the inset core body, sampled at 10 Hz. Not a count of physical collisions.
sampling: 27 points per braid cuboid; |x| < 5.6, 0.05 < y < 8.2, -4.55 < z < 4.0. Excludes shallow side attachment overlap.
limitations: This comparison covers braid/core-body penetration. It does not certify zero overlap for hair, hat, sword or child meshes. Hat care is excluded from the before/after count because its choreography was replaced.
